eldergrove_ceremonial_gate_leaf_v001.notes: Single paired Moonroot leaves, bronze-collared roots, no neon/portal/animals.

crownlands_ceremonial_gate_leaf_v001.notes: Single paired Meridian leaves, pale limestone/silver/blue-slate, restrained bronze, not cathedral.

umbral_ceremonial_gate_leaf_v001.notes: Single paired Ashvein leaves, smoked-glass slits, ember hairline cracks, no portal/violet fog.

shared_save_pillar_hero_form_v001.notes: Shared 4.5m tapered bind-pillar, top socket, flared base, 1.8m mannequin.

eldergrove_save_pillar_ornament_v001.notes: Shared silhouette, bronze root overlay, top socket, mannequin, readable 0-2m bar.

crownlands_save_pillar_ornament_v001.notes: Attempt1 rejected: side-facing socket. Retry keeps top socket, limestone/silver/blue-slate overlay.

umbral_save_pillar_ornament_v001.notes: Shared silhouette, graphite/yoke bands, ember cracks, top socket, no portal.

shared_adjacent_realm_bridge_kit_v001.notes: Plan/elevation/section modular bay kit with Worldscar gulf and mannequin. 180m length remains V013; pixels show a representative bay not a measured 180m span.

stonehold_bridge_abutment_v001.notes: One abutment + deck stub + material callout. Basalt/iron-gold. Correct 0-2m bar.

eldergrove_bridge_abutment_v001.notes: One abutment + deck stub. Bronze-collared roots are visual overlay; Blender must not make them climbable.

crownlands_bridge_abutment_v001.notes: One abutment + deck stub. Pale limestone, silver ribs, blue-slate cap, restrained bronze.

umbral_bridge_abutment_v001.notes: One abutment + deck stub. Graphite/ash-timber/ember cracks. Pointed smoked-glass slits lean gothic; Blender should rebuild as fault slits, not cathedral tracery.
